title: Listen and Choose a Response — Travel

questions.stem: How long does it take to renew a passport?

options.A: It depends, but you can pay extra to speed it up.
options.B: About five hundred miles from here.
options.C: Yes, it's time to renew it.
options.D: I keep my passport in a drawer.

questions.explanation: A 'how long' question is answered indirectly with useful information. The others answer distance, use Yes, or say where the passport is.
questions.speaker: f4
